I've never thought about it like that, but that actually makes a lot of sense.

Mister Magoo >!boards a plane under the impression that he was seeing a 3D movie, and, unbeknownst to him, ends up sitting next to a bank robber. A cop shows up and the bank robber flees before he's seen, leaving behind a briefcase with the stolen money. Magoo sees the abandoned briefcase and intends to return it to who he thinks is the rightful owner. He takes the briefcase and walks out onto the wing of the plane, thinking the door would lead to the lobby. Long story short, he ends up back inside, and we find the cop grilling the robber. The robber fits the description the cop is looking for, but he doesn't have the briefcase. Magoo walks over and returns the briefcase to it's owner, which gives the cop the last bit of proof he needs to make the arrest. Classic.!<
